title: Brand Press Kit Download
description: A media assets and brand press resource section with vector logos, color codes, and download bundles.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Brand Press Kit Download Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
